expected.note: PTC disallowed entirely: household income above 400% of FPL ($81,680 for family of three)
expected.snippet: Because petitioner's household income for her family size is greater than 400% of the federal poverty line amount, she does not qualify for the PTC.

expected.note: court states $6,874.50 (all APTC paid, July-December at $1,145.75); rounded half-up to whole dollars; no repayment limitation applies
expected.snippet: Since petitioner does not qualify for the PTC, she owes the APTC payments of $6,874.50 made on her behalf as a tax liability.

expected.note: court uses reported MAGI as household income (household size three); equals sum of reported wages, interest, retirement distributions and additional income
expected.snippet: Petitioner, who has a household size of three persons, reported MAGI of $113,721; this amount is greater than $81,680
Respondent concedes the early withdrawal penalty and further concedes the accuracy-related penalty.

expected.note: conceded by respondent (notice's early withdrawal penalty on IRA distributions); court gives no reasoning
expected.snippet: Respondent concedes the early withdrawal penalty and further concedes the accuracy-related penalty.

issues_outside_coverage: Deficiency: decision under Rule 155 with no final deficiency figure stated; no deficiency value recorded in this key (notice deficiency was $7,104, which included the conceded early withdrawal penalty)
Collectibility / collection alternative for financial hardship is not at issue in a section 6213(a) deficiency proceeding
Burden of proof under section 7491(a) does not shift
decisive_judgment_findings: Household size of three; MAGI/household income of $113,721 exceeded 400% of the federal poverty line ($81,680)
Petitioner did not dispute the determination on technical grounds
Marketplace eligibility resulted from petitioner's apparent misunderstanding of the application instructions (does not change the outcome)
